([[Norcross, Georgia]]) | college = [[Virginia Cavaliers men's basketball|Virginia]] (2011–2016) | draft_year = | draft_round = | draft_pick = | draft_team = | career_start = | years1 = | team1 = | highlights = * Consensus second-team [[NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans|All-American]] ([[2015 NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans|2015]]) * Consensus first-team All-American ([[2016 NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans|2016]]) * [[NABC Defensive Player of the Year]] (2016) * [[Atlantic Coast Conference Men's Basketball Player of the Year|ACC Player of the Year]] (2016) * 3× First-team All-[[Atlantic Coast Conference|ACC]] (2014–2016) * 2× ACC Defensive Player of the Year (2015, 2016) | medaltemplates = {{Medal|Country|the {{USA}}}} {{Medal|Competition|[[Pan American Games]]}} {{Medal|Bronze |[[2015 Pan American Games|2015 Toronto]] | [[Basketball at the 2015 Pan American Games|National team]]}} }} '''Malcolm Moses Adams Brogdon''' (born December 11, 1992) is an American [[basketball]] player who recently completed his college career for the [[Virginia Cavaliers men's basketball]] team. He was named to the All-[[Atlantic Coast Conference]] (ACC) First Team in [[2013–14 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2014]] by the league's coaches and to the third team by the media. Was also named ACC player of the year for the 2015-16 season. ==College career== Brogdon [[redshirt (college sports)|redshirted]] [[2012–13 Virginia Cavaliers men's basketball team|his sophomore year]] after suffering a serious foot injury the prior season. He was known as one of the top contributors to the team's successful 2013–14 and 2014–15 seasons. In the 2013-14 season Brogdon averaged 12.7 points, 5.4 rebounds, and 2.7 assists per game. He is a member of the Academic Honor Roll and currently pursuing a masters degree in public policy at the [[Frank Batten School of Leadership and Public Policy]]. {{cite web|title=Malcolm Brogdon Bio|url=http://www.virginiasports.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/malcolm_brogdon_791198.html|website=VirginiaSports.com|accessdate=30 July 2014}} In 2015, he was named as a consensus second-team [[2015 NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans|All American]], as well as the All-ACC First Team and ACC Co-Defensive Player of the year. In July 2015, he participated in the training camp for the [[United States men's national basketball team]],{{cite press release |url=http://www.virginiasports.com/sports/m-baskbl/spec-rel/062915aab.html |title= Brogdon Selected for U.S. Pan American Men’s Basketball Team Training Camp |publisher=[[Virginia Cavaliers]] |date=June 29, 2015 |accessdate=June 30, 2015}} and represented the United States at the [[Basketball at the 2015 Pan American Games|2015 Pan American Games]],{{cite news |url=http://www.nbc29.com/story/29530164/uvas-malcolm-brogdon-to-compete-for-team-usa-at-pan-american-games |title=UVa's Malcolm Brogdon to Compete for Team USA at Pan American Games
